figures.caption: Table 2. Comparison of AI users and non-users across writing stages and individual factors. Values show group means (𝑀 , 𝑆𝐷 ; 𝑛) for each group. All scales range from 1–5, with higher values indicating more favorable evaluations. Test statistics are reported as Welch’s 𝑡 (df). Significance is indicated with ∗𝑝 < .05, ∗∗𝑝 < .01, ∗∗∗𝑝 < .001.
